instruction.pos: Your response should follow a question-answer pattern. Frame key points as questions and then answer them systematically.

instruction.pos: Break down your response into a series of self-posed questions with corresponding answers. Use this format to organize all information.
instruction.neg: Write in a conventional format without posing questions to yourself. Present information directly without the Q&A structure.
